findings: New wave-3 template distilled from a recurring field workflow pattern; no prior library source existed.
The field pattern was a multi-agent prototype whose records lived in agent flows, not in a portable single-file agent.
Field-pattern records used calendar dates and names that could resemble real titles, brands, or organizations.
fixes: Rebuilt the workflow as a single-file, stdlib-only agent with 4 deterministic operations over an invented snapshot.
Replaced every external action with a labeled draft and an explicit no-action gate; replaced calendar dates with relative demo timing.
Used only fictional organizations, people, identifiers, and values, renaming any record that could resemble a real title or brand.
Added one locked persona-language case and one uploadable skill per operation.
remaining_boundary: Production connections and all external actions require customer approval, least-privilege controls, and an authorized human workflow.
